about.title: About Me
about.text: Process automation and AI agent specialist, focused on n8n, REST API integrations, and end-to-end workflow architecture. My background is 100% practical: I built my expertise by automating real processes for companies. I don't just connect tools; I design the logic behind each flow to be robust, scalable, and easy to maintain. I understand business logic, allowing me to translate business needs into systems that actually work, without over-engineering.

p1.title: Multi-Model AI Agent with Fallback
p1.problem: High AI operational costs and occasional failures due to primary API downtime.
p1.tools: n8n, Gemini Pro/Flash, Telegram, Google Sheets
p1.automation: Resilient orchestration system with Dynamic Selector. Evaluates response quality and automatically retries (Error Trigger) switching models upon failure.
p1.result: 40% reduction in AI spend and 0% service interruption.
p1.benefit: Continuous operation and extreme API cost optimization.

p2.title: End-to-End Pipeline: PDF to Podcast
p2.problem: Bottlenecks in audio content production from extensive technical documents.
p2.tools: n8n, Azure TTS, GPT-4, Google Drive
p2.automation: Ingestion flow extracting text from PDFs, applying AI semantic cleaning, requiring human approval via Telegram, and synthesizing voice to generate an RSS XML.
p2.result: Production time reduced from 4 hours to 15 minutes.
p2.benefit: Scalability in multi-channel content creation without quality loss.

p3.title: Conversational RAG Agent with Memory
p3.problem: Lack of historical context in support bot interactions with returning users.
p3.automation: Intelligent chatbot that dynamically queries a history in Sheets, extracting conversational memory before generating contextualized responses.
p3.result: 100% accurate and contextual responses for users.
p3.benefit: Seamless user experience and reduction in human support escalations.

p4.title: Sales Autopilot (Affiliate Marketing)
p4.problem: Low conversion rates and high time investment in sourcing social media assets.
p4.automation: Automated sales funnel evaluating daily limits, extracting prompts from approved catalogs, sourcing stock video, and orchestrating rendering via a Python engine.
p4.benefit: Aggressive scaling of marketing campaigns with zero manual intervention.
